derivation.mechanism_caveat: THE SHORTER-BAND EXPLANATION IS CONTESTED. The same search returned sources stating that this interpretation is outmoded and that haustration is now more commonly attributed to enteric-nervous-system activity driving segmental circular-muscle contraction, in which case haustra are a DYNAMIC pattern rather than a fixed consequence of band shortening. This model implements the geometric relation because it is the one that can be derived and measured back; that is a modelling choice and NOT a claim that the ENS account is wrong.
